intro: Start with the site name, language and user permissions. Your changes are saved together using Save.
The entire logo is centered automatically. Drag or zoom only when you want to crop it. Fit image restores the whole image.
Choose a logo from your computer. Review the preview before saving. Images are only replaced when you change them.
Configure the encoder and email here. Save changes before using Test Email.
Health Check runs the same diagnostics available in the admin dashboard. Opening it does not discard your changes.
Save applies your edits. Wait for the confirmation; if saving fails, your draft stays available so you can try again.
